purpose.zh: 强化上背部，改善肩部活动
purpose.en: Strengthen your upper back and improve shoulder mobility.

text.zh: 胸口微抬，直臂从头顶划到髋旁
text.en: Keep your chest slightly lifted and sweep straight arms from overhead to your hips

text.zh: 俯卧，双腿伸直，手臂离地悬空
text.en: Lie face down, legs long, arms hovering just off the floor.

text.zh: 到髋旁时掌心朝上，再划回头顶
text.en: Turn your palms up at your hips, then sweep back overhead.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to lift too high.

cautions.zh: 腰部或肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back or shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
